The person behind the studio

Your ideas.
A practical partner.

Coal River Standard is led by Sean Wilmot near Saint Albans, West Virginia. We help small businesses turn their ideas into a clear presence online.

A direct point
of contact.

You work with Sean on the direction, content, and approvals. Projects can be handled online, so progress does not depend on repeated in-person meetings.

We use design and development tools, including AI-assisted tools, with human direction and review. The focus is a useful result with a scope you understand.

What matters here

  • Plain-language communication
  • Written scope before work begins
  • Clear separation of build and ongoing costs
  • Your approval before public launch

How a project works

From the first idea
to the final check.

  1. 1

    Define the project

    Discuss your business, content, and required features. Agree on the scope, price, and schedule in writing.

  2. 2

    Review and refine

    Review a private draft and share consolidated feedback. Website packages include two revision rounds within scope.

  3. 3

    Approve and launch

    Complete the checks, approve the finished work, connect the domain, and receive the agreed handoff.
